name: free-claude-code
description: Use Claude Code, Codex, VSCode, Pi, and OpenCode (and 6 other harnesses) for free (1.3B+ free tokens) from your terminal, app, IDE, or phone, and now from the browser with native browser sessions (multi-harness + multi-model) like OpenClaw (voice supported + ToS friendly)
one_liner: A free router that lets you use AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Codex by tapping into free token allowances from dozens of providers instead of paying for them directly.
buyer: A student, bootcamp learner, or budget-conscious indie hacker who wants to use top-tier AI coding tools regularly without paying monthly subscription costs.
business_use_cases: A coding bootcamp or university club points students at it so they get real AI coding assistant practice without each student needing a paid subscription.
A solo indie hacker uses it to build side projects with multiple AI coding agents for free instead of juggling several paid plans.
A freelance developer uses the automatic failover between providers to keep working through an outage or rate limit on their main AI provider.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'managed setup' service: configure and maintain this for a small team's shared developer machines.
Sell a premium support tier (priority provider routing, monitoring) layered on top of the free core tool.

steal_this: Hard to monetize honestly — its whole pitch is helping people avoid paying for AI tools, so the fastest 'business' here is really just free personal usage, not a product to sell.
